model: Sensedge Mini Indoor Air Quality Monitor (SE-200 / SE-200P)
applies_to: Kaiterra Sensedge Mini SE-200 and SE-200P indoor air quality monitors with BACnet IP.
summary: The Sensedge Mini is an indoor air quality monitor built around swappable sensor modules. Over BACnet IP it exposes one Analog Input per measurement (PM2.5, PM10, TVOC, temperature, humidity, CO2, ozone, NO2, CO, differential pressure and module lifespans) at fixed instance numbers.
notes: From the Analog Input table in the Sensedge Mini PICS (September 2026). Instance numbers are fixed per measurement.
Only the AIs for the installed sensor modules are present; the device updates Object_List and Database_Revision when modules change.
AI 8 and AI 9 are both printed as "KM20X Module Lifespan". No units are printed in the table.
Present_Value is writable only while Out_Of_Service is TRUE; Units, COV_Increment and Out_Of_Service are writable.

source.title: Kaiterra Sensedge Mini BACnet Protocol Implementation Conformance Statement (PICS)

integration.summary: Read the AIs for the measurements fitted to the unit. Re-read the object list after sensor modules are added or removed. COV subscriptions are supported.
setup: BACnet IP over Ethernet or 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; UDP port 47808 by default and user-configurable.
The device instance is user-set (Object_Identifier is writable); the default object name is "Kaiterra-SE-200".
Foreign device registration to a remote BBMD is supported.
gotchas: Units can only be changed for TVOC (ppb or µg/m³) and Temperature (°C or °F); other unit writes are rejected.
